title: 第11章 已有取死之道！
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
“怎么？不愿意？”沈冲的声音开始变得阴冷起来。

    余文宏一呆之后，立刻满脸堆笑地回道：“沈少您稍等，我这就给她打电话……”

    “哈哈哈哈……”沈大公子忍不住放声大笑，伸手拍着余文宏的肩膀，如同拍着自家养的一条狗。

    “够聪明，够果断，也够无耻！啧啧，你还真是让我刮目相看啊！”

    听着沈冲带有侮辱性的调侃，余文宏只是尴尬地笑着，不敢多说一句话。

    只要能搭上沈家这艘大船，头上戴点儿绿怎么了，怎么了？

    况且只是女朋友而已，又不是老婆，将来不结婚不就行了？

    笑过之后，沈冲用异样的眼神打量着对方，语气柔和地说道：“你放心，我这个人，眼光很高的。你女朋友是不错，但也仅仅是不错而已。”

    他沈冲上过的女人，哪个不是千娇百媚的极品？

    只是在看见李清妍后，这些女人似乎也都变成了庸脂俗粉。

    站起身，拍了拍身上并不存在的灰尘，沈大公子意味深长地说了一句：“女人就不必找了，你们帮我找个男人，嗯，他叫梁惟石，可能再过一个多月，就会到文曲县委办上班，这个人，我非常不喜欢！你们明白吗？”

    余文宏和丁强明白吗？

    余文宏和丁强太明白了！

    虽然不清楚梁惟石怎么得罪了沈大公子，但这根本不重要，往死里整就对了！

    余文宏更是暗自称快，原本听说市领导对梁惟石印象很好，他这边即使怀恨在心却也不敢轻举妄动，现在好了，有沈公子撑腰，保管黑的白的加在一起让梁惟石吃不了兜着走。

    强哥也在摩拳擦掌，跃跃欲试，心里想着是让那个姓梁的拄拐走路好呢，还是干脆一点直接让对方坐轮椅好呢！

    ……

    沈冲意兴索然地离开了狂浪酒吧，在保镖的护送下回到了宾馆。

    点起一支烟，倚在沙发上，眼前浮现的尽是那天饭局上李清妍的一颦一笑。

    说实话，他似乎从未对一个女孩这样动心过。

    甚至到了‘求之不得，寤寐思服。悠哉悠哉，辗转反侧。’的地步。

    以前无论多漂亮的女人，只要他想得，都很好得，一得就能得到。

    而现在，他却连邀请李清妍单独见面都做不到！
content_en:
"What? Not willing?" Shen Chong's voice began to turn cold.

After Yu Wenhong was stunned, he immediately replied with a smile on his face: "Master Shen, please wait a moment, I will call her right now..."

"Hahahaha..." Mr. Shen couldn't help laughing loudly, and reached out to pat Yu Wenhong on the shoulder, like patting a dog he raised.

"You're smart enough, decisive enough, and shameless enough! Gee, you really impress me!"

Listening to Shen Chong's insulting ridicule, Yu Wenhong just smiled awkwardly and did not dare to say another word.

As long as you can board the Shen family's big ship, what's wrong with wearing a little green on your head?

Besides, she's just a girlfriend, not a wife. Isn't it okay if she doesn't get married in the future?

After laughing, Shen Chong looked at the other party with strange eyes and said in a soft tone: "Don't worry, I have very high standards. Your girlfriend is not bad, but she is just good."

Of all the women he had fallen in love with, which one was not the most charming and charming?

But after seeing Li Qingyan, these women seemed to have turned into vulgar fans.

Standing up and patting the non-existent dust on his body, Mr. Shen said meaningfully: "There is no need to look for a woman. You can help me find a man. Well, his name is Liang Weishi. In more than a month, he will go to work at the Wenqu County Committee Office. I don't like this man very much! Do you understand?"

Do Yu Wenhong and Ding Qiang understand?

Yu Wenhong and Ding Qiang understand it so well!

Although it is not clear why Liang Weishi offended Mr. Shen, it is not important at all, as long as he is punished to death!

Yu Wenhong even secretly said that he was happy. I originally heard that the city leader had a good impression of Liang Weishi. Even if he had a grudge, he did not dare to act rashly. Now it is better. With the support of Mr. Shen, Liang Weishi can't bear to keep the black and white.

Brother Qiang was also gearing up and eager to give it a try. He was thinking whether it would be better to let the man named Liang walk on crutches, or simply let him use a wheelchair!

…

Shen Chong left the Wild Wave Bar in a dull mood and returned to the hotel under the escort of bodyguards.

Lighting a cigarette and leaning on the sofa, all that appeared in front of his eyes was Li Qingyan's smile at the dinner that day.

To be honest, it seemed like he had never been so attracted to a girl.

Even to the point of ‘I can’t get what I want, and I sleep hard and think about it.Leisurely leisurely, tossing and turning.’ point.

In the past, no matter how beautiful a woman was, as long as he wanted it, it was very good and he could get it as soon as he got it.

But now, he can't even invite Li Qingyan to meet alone!
title_en: Chapter 11 There is a way to die!
